 Ron Howard Calls Wife Cheryl His Career’s ‘Secret Weapon’: ‘She’s Been So Influential’ (Exclusive)
 Jack Smart, Esther Lian 2026년 11월 12일 목 오후 10:41 UTC 1 Ron Howard and Cheryl Howard in September 2024Credit: Cindy Ord/Getty NEED TO KNOW
 Ron Howard speaks exclusively to PEOPLE at the 2026 DOC NYC Visionaries Lunch at Gotham Hall on Nov. 11
 Cheryl, his wife of 51 years, has been “a secret weapon my whole career,” says the director
 “I’m more like an editorial mind, whereas she is an author,” Ron says of their relationship as creatives
 Ron Howard ‘s wife Cheryl plays a key role in his creative endeavors. 
 “She’s been a secret weapon my whole career,” Ron, 72, tells PEOPLE at the 2026 DOC NYC Visionaries Lunch at Gotham Hall in New York City on Wednesday, Nov. 11. 
 “She’s very outside the box,” adds the Oscar-winning A Beautiful Mind filmmaker. His wife of 51 years is “quiet,” he says, “but she thinks in very surprising and creative ways. She’s been so influential.”
 Cheryl Howard and Ron Howard in 2017Credit: C Flanigan/Getty Cheryl, 72, is a published author. She and Ron met in English class during their junior year at John Burroughs High School in Burbank, Calif. They tied the knot on June 7, 1975, and share four children together : daughters Bryce , Paige and Jocelyn, and son Reed .
 “I don’t think of myself as a writer,” Ron tells PEOPLE. “I work closely with writers. I think creatively, structurally about the work that I do. But I’m more like an editorial mind, whereas she is an author.”

 He adds that they both are “always” exchanging their creative projects in progress.
 “I love reading her stuff, and she reads my scripts, sees my cuts and contributes from the beginning to the end,” Ron says. “I’ve been very blessed to be her guy.”
 Ron Howard at the 2026 DOC NYC Visionaries Lunch at Gotham Hall on Nov. 11Credit: Theo Wargo/Getty Earlier this month, Ron and Cheryl marked the anniversary of their first date : as high school sweethearts, they caught a re-release of It’s a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World and grabbed pizza. 
 Moviegoing is still an important part of their relationship 56 years later, says Ron. “Our romantic life has often been built around going to the movies, and that kind of dried up after COVID… Now we’ve just rediscovered going back to the movies at least once a week and having a date.”
 Avedon , Ron’s new documentary about the late photographer Richard Avedon , premiered on Netflix on Nov. 11.
 Howard’s other upcoming directing projects include the war drama Alone at Dawn , starring Anne Hathaway and Adam Driver , and a reunion with Jim Carrey for a sequel to How the Grinch Stole Christmas .
